newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on political fears.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on political fears.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall marginally in Sunday trading amid selling by small investors, brokers said.
"The retail investors are a bit panicked by looming political uncertainty. They will watch the market for some time," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.

Brokers said investors have been shaken by threats from the main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) to launch a movement to bring down the government. They said shares prices might fall across the board.
The DSE all-share price index closed 42.28 points or 2.48 percent lower at 1,660.21 on turnover of 55.5 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh
